minecraft:blackstone_stairs: Stairs made of blackstone. Craft six blackstone in a stair shape for four, or use a stonecutter. They suit dark, Nether-style builds.
minecraft:gilded_blackstone: Blackstone flecked with gold, found in bastion remnants. Mining it sometimes drops gold nuggets instead. Piglins get angry if they see you break it.
minecraft:polished_blackstone: Blackstone polished into a smooth, dark block. Craft four blackstone into four, or use a stonecutter. It makes buttons, pressure plates and bricks.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_slab: Half a block of polished blackstone. Craft three in a row for six, or use a stonecutter. Two slabs in one space make a full block.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_stairs: Stairs made of polished blackstone. Craft six in a stair shape for four, or use a stonecutter. They give a clean, dark step.
minecraft:chiseled_polished_blackstone: Polished blackstone carved with a piglin face. Craft two polished blackstone slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It is found in bastion remnants.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_bricks: Dark bricks made from polished blackstone, the main block of bastions. Craft four polished blackstone into four, or use a stonecutter. Smelt them for a cracked version.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_brick_slab: Half a block of polished blackstone bricks. Craft three in a row for six, or use a stonecutter. It suits bastion-style builds.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_brick_stai: Stairs made of polished blackstone bricks. Craft six in a stair shape for four, or use a stonecutter. They suit bastion-style builds.
minecraft:cracked_polished_blackstone_br: Polished blackstone bricks with cracks across them. Smelt polished blackstone bricks to make them. They give builds a ruined look.
minecraft:respawn_anchor: A block that lets you set your respawn point in the Nether. Charge it with glowstone and use it to set your spawn; each respawn uses a charge. Used outside the Nether, it explodes.
minecraft:candle: A plain candle made from string and honeycomb. Light it with flint and steel; up to four fit in one block. Dye it to change its color.
minecraft:white_candle: A white candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and white dye.
minecraft:orange_candle: A orange candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and orange dye.

minecraft:small_amethyst_bud: The first stage of an amethyst crystal growing on budding amethyst. It slowly grows bigger. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing.
minecraft:medium_amethyst_bud: The second stage of an amethyst crystal. It keeps growing into a large bud. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing.
minecraft:large_amethyst_bud: The third stage of an amethyst crystal, almost fully grown. It soon becomes a cluster. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing.
minecraft:amethyst_cluster: A fully grown amethyst crystal. Mine it with a pickaxe for four amethyst shards, or more with Fortune. It glows faintly and chimes.
minecraft:pointed_dripstone: A sharp spike of dripstone that hangs from ceilings or rises from floors. Falling onto it hurts more, and spikes overhead fall when broken. Dripping water or lava from it can fill a cauldron below.
minecraft:ochre_froglight: A glowing block made when a temperate (orange) frog eats a small magma cube. It gives off full light. It has a warm yellow color.
minecraft:verdant_froglight: A glowing block made when a cold (green) frog eats a small magma cube. It gives off full light. It has a soft green color.
minecraft:pearlescent_froglight: A glowing block made when a warm (white) frog eats a small magma cube. It gives off full light. It has a pale pink-purple color.
minecraft:frogspawn: Eggs laid by frogs on water. They hatch into tadpoles after a while. They can't be picked up.
minecraft:echo_shard: A mysterious shard found only in ancient city chests. Eight of them around a compass craft a recovery compass. It has no other use yet.
minecraft:brush: A tool for archaeology made from a feather, a copper ingot and a stick. Brush suspicious sand and gravel to uncover buried items. It also collects scutes from armadillos.
minecraft:netherite_upgrade_smithing_tem: A template that upgrades diamond gear to netherite at a smithing table, along with a netherite ingot. It is found in bastion remnant chests. Copy it with seven diamonds and netherrack.

minecraft:copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It oxidizes over time; wax it with honeycomb to keep its shine.
minecraft:exposed_copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It has started to oxidize and keeps aging unless waxed.
minecraft:weathered_copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is mostly oxidized; wax it to keep this look or scrape it with an axe.
minecraft:oxidized_copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is fully oxidized; an axe scrapes the patina off.
minecraft:waxed_copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax, so it never oxidizes.
minecraft:waxed_exposed_copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax at the first stage of oxidation.
minecraft:waxed_weathered_copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax in its mostly green stage.
minecraft:waxed_oxidized_copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax in its fully teal stage.

minecraft:exposed_copper_bulb: A copper lamp that switches on or off with each redstone pulse, giving off slightly dimmer light. Craft three copper blocks, a blaze rod and redstone into four. It has started to oxidize and keeps aging unless waxed.
minecraft:weathered_copper_bulb: A copper lamp that switches on or off with each redstone pulse, giving off dim light. Craft three copper blocks, a blaze rod and redstone into four. It is mostly oxidized; wax it to keep this look or scrape it with an axe.
minecraft:oxidized_copper_bulb: A copper lamp that switches on or off with each redstone pulse, giving off faint light. Craft three copper blocks, a blaze rod and redstone into four. It is fully oxidized; an axe scrapes the patina off.
minecraft:waxed_copper_bulb: A copper lamp that switches on or off with each redstone pulse, giving off full light. Craft three copper blocks, a blaze rod and redstone into four. It is sealed with wax, so it never oxidizes.

minecraft:trial_spawner: A spawner in trial chambers that releases waves of mobs when players come near. Defeating them rewards trial keys and loot. It can't be obtained.
minecraft:trial_key: A key dropped by trial spawners when you beat their mobs. Use it to open a vault in trial chambers. Each vault opens once per player.
minecraft:ominous_trial_key: A key dropped by ominous trial spawners. Use it to open an ominous vault, which holds better rewards like the heavy core. Each vault opens once per player.
minecraft:vault: A locked treasure box in trial chambers. Unlock it with a trial key to receive loot; it remembers who opened it. It can't be obtained.
minecraft:ominous_bottle: A bottle dropped by raid captains. Drinking it gives Bad Omen, which turns trial chambers ominous or starts a raid in a village. Its level sets how strong the effect is.
minecraft:breeze_rod: A rod dropped by breezes in trial chambers. It crafts into four wind charges. Combined with a heavy core it makes the mace.
